Layer 2 of the native PR stack following #14348 replaces helper-process mocks in the git client graph, ref, branch configuration, push configuration, tag, checkout, path, and worktree test clusters with hermetic local Git repositories. The tests now assert repository state and semantic errors through the layer 1 `testRepo` harness without changing production behavior.

   Given I was in a repo with no open pull requests
   When I ran `gh pr list`
   Then I saw "no open pull requests in cli/cli"
3. A natural language walkthrough of what you did by hand, the states you covered, and what
   you saw, including error and edge cases.

If you leave this empty, your pull request will very likely be closed.

Not tested manually because this change only refactors automated tests and does not alter user-visible behavior.

### Key points

<!--
Tradeoffs you accepted, alternatives you rejected, and anything a reviewer would otherwise have to guess at.

- The malformed symbolic push-ref case remains synthetic because portable real Git cannot produce that output.
- Pure parser tests remain synthetic for malformed and cross-platform fixture cases.
- Broader test-suite consolidation is intentionally deferred to a later stack layer.
